text_block_list.text:
One day, feeling thirsty, I walked into a cafe
and found Zenno Rob Roy there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! It's a long piece,
so I was just about to take a break anyway.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...This shop has such a nice atmosphere,
it's really easy to focus here.

They must have been at the restaurant for quite a while.
The table was lined with empty plates...
choice_data_list: Did all that reading make you hungry?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! I just thought it'd be rude
to the restaurant if I didn't order anything...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I knew it was asking too much,
but I just really wanted to read it here...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Here is your afternoon tea set.
Please, enjoy your time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I was planning to keep reading,
so I completely forgot that I'd ordered it...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-To be honest, I'm already pretty full...
...B-But it'd be rude not to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, that smell. It's a flavor I love...!
Maybe I can eat it? No, but—
choice_data_list: Shall we eat something else instead?
I think you'll be fine if you just eat at your own pace!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...?
I was truly at my limit, so that's a lifesaver...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad it looks like you'll enjoy it...
Here you go, Trainer...!
I paid for the meal and ended up eating the food in Zenno Rob Roy's place. As a result, I managed to keep her from overeating.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
If I eat between reading sessions, I think I can finish it...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: What is this feeling... It's like I'm heading into battle...!

Zenno Rob Roy somehow managed to
finish all the food she ordered.
